issue_context.title: sched framework: expose NodeInfo in all functions of PluginsRunner interface
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

Scheduler framework exposes a series of functions in PluginsRunner interface for out-of-tree plugins to implement custom functionalities:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/6f8d38406a7f16fc9cc9b72789a9b826105b1b54/pkg/scheduler/framework/interface.go#L601-L605

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/6f8d38406a7f16fc9cc9b72789a9b826105b1b54/pkg/scheduler/framework/interface.go#L725-L750

However, `RunPreScorePlugins` and `RunScorePlugins` exposes `Node` instead of `NodeInfo` like other functions. It causes inconvenient UX for plugin users like [koordinator](https://github.com/koordinator-sh/koordinator). For example, one of the requirements is to find an optimal preemption candidate node in PostFilter plugins. `NodeInfo` carries important extra info during the preemption dryrun, and w/o consuming `NodeInfo`, running `Run{Pre}ScorePlugins` would be non-sense. To work around it, users have to plumb very specific and sometime ugly semantics themselves which should have been avoided.

### Why is this needed?

- consistent function signature - all use NodeInfo
- unleash more potential to use scheduler framework natively w/o hacks

review_comments: Is this the only case where we have this loop?

Yes, `findNodesThatPassExtenders`'s return values got changed. So we change it's return value back to node in test for convenient.

Although there are other functions which have the same change in return value. We don't seem to have tests for these functions(like `findNodesThatPassFilters`).

So, currently, this is the only case.

`tf` is already used in many places, for example: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/0c645922edcc06adff43c70c02fb56751364bbb5/pkg/scheduler/scheduler_test.go#L55

Should I rename all imports under package scheduler to `testingframework` ?
I see. Let's leave it then
We can **not** use `testing/framework.BuildNodeInfos` in package `framework/runtime`, because it will cause a cycle import. So I made a copy of the function here.

Hmm, if we do not change the extender. We'll always get a list of node as candidates in filter, right?
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/0c645922edcc06adff43c70c02fb56751364bbb5/pkg/scheduler/schedule_one.go#L503
And if we just pass this node list to score extension, it's just the same as we don't change at all.
Are you suggesting in L503 here, we pass a node list from nodeInfos and get a result list, and use this result list to filter out some nodeInfos from previous result list? Like this?
```
	nodeInfos, err := sched.findNodesThatPassFilters(ctx, fwk, state, pod, &diagnosis, nodes)
	nds, err = findNodesThatPassExtenders(ctx, sched.Extenders, pod, framework.GetNodes(nodeInfos), diagnosis.NodeToStatusMap)

	// return nodeInfo if it's node is in "nds"
	return getNodeInfos(nodeInfos,nds), diagnosis, nil
```
However this also could be quite expensive in a big cluster.
I can't think of a better way to deal with it🤔️.

I see.

Let's leave the changes here and work on the other comments.
